query:
UPDATE advent_calendars
                SET
                    name = $2,
                    starts_at = $3,
                    top_message = $4,
                    button_text = $5,
                    staff_notes = $6,
                    late_opening_policy = $7,
                    late_opening_grace_hours = $8,
                    published = $9
                WHERE id = $1
                RETURNING id
